def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # A horizontal colored line separates upper marker from lower marker.
    # Extend the upper marker vertically in color 4 through the zero rows above separator.
    sep=next((i for i,r in enumerate(g) if r and len(set(r))==1 and r[0]==2),None)
    if sep is None: return g
    top=next((i for i in range(sep) if any(v != 0 for v in g[i])),None)
    if top is None: return g
    for c,v in enumerate(g[top]):
        if v:
            for r in range(top+1,sep):
                if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=4
    return g
